mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 4.7% signals accelerating labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.7

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from their 3-month moving averages indicates broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their 3-month moving averages

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually), the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5% annually

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 205 indicates elevated inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 205

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market downturn (HOUST below 1300 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 1300

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals recessionary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS falls
